title: Keep a register of unclaimed money
what: Keep a register of unclaimed money and deal with it as the Act requires (including paying it to the Treasurer, s 7).

sources.title: Unclaimed Money Act 2015 (Tas)
sources.quote: A holder of unclaimed money to which this Part applies must – (a) establish, in the prescribed form, a register, of all unclaimed money, that is at or readily accessible from its principal office or place of business;

sources.title: Unclaimed Money Act 2015 (Tas)
sources.locator: s 4, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current)
sources.quote: The Treasurer may – (a) by notice, determine a relevant minimum amount, in relation to holders generally, for the purposes of subsection (2)(c) ;

reach.condition: if it holds unclaimed money to which the Act applies
